summary: Character creation event: a companion (origin) was selected for a user. Created on a new event entity by bg3.exe+0x37969B0 (AllocRaw 0x10) from bg3.exe+0x3791C80, which writes the companion handle and the user id; read by esv::StoryCharacterEventManager::Init's event handlers (Osiris). Registered as a normal component although named OneFrame. Twin of CharacterSelectedForUserOneFrameComponent. Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (server row).

fields.name: Companion
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x37969B0 writes 0xffc0000000000000 (null EntityHandle) at +0; writer bg3.exe+0x3791C80 line 340 copies to +0 the 8-byte value at +0x10 of a record it holds (the companion's handle, also returned to the caller).

fields.name: User
fields.evidence: Creator writes the global at bg3.exe+0x617CEAC (default UserID) at +8; writer line 341 stores its fourth argument there as a 4-byte value.
